name: Flat Barbell Bench Press
description: Press a barbell from chest level while lying on a flat bench.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: Press dumbbells upward on an incline bench with controlled movement.

name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
description: Press the Smith machine bar upward from an incline bench.

name: Cable Chest Press
description: Press cable handles forward while keeping the shoulder blades controlled.

name: Pec Deck
description: Bring the machine handles together in front of the chest with controlled movement.

name: Push-Up
description: Lower and press the body from a plank position using bodyweight.

name: Dip
description: Lower and press the body on parallel bars. Record weight as 0 for bodyweight or enter only the added external weight for weighted dips.

name: Pull-Up
description: Pull the body upward until the chin clears the bar. Record weight as 0 for bodyweight or enter only the added external weight for weighted pull-ups.

name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
description: Pull a barbell toward the torso while maintaining a hinged position.

name: T-Bar Row
description: Pull a loaded T-bar toward the torso while maintaining a stable hip hinge.

name: Machine T-Bar Row
description: Pull the handles of a chest-supported T-bar row machine toward the torso.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: Pull a cable attachment toward the torso from a seated position.

name: Face Pull
description: Pull a rope attachment toward the face while rotating the upper arms outward.

name: Deadlift
description: Lift a barbell from the floor by extending the hips and knees.

name: Back Squat
description: Squat with a barbell supported across the upper back.

name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
description: Lower a barbell through a hip hinge while keeping the knees slightly bent.

name: Walking Lunge
description: Step forward into alternating lunges while keeping the torso upright.

name: Pistol Squat
description: Perform a controlled single-leg squat while extending the other leg forward.

name: Leg Extension
description: Extend the knees against the resistance of a leg extension machine.

name: Leg Curl
description: Flex the knees against the resistance of a leg curl machine.

name: Hip Thrust
description: Extend the hips against resistance while the upper back rests on a bench.

name: Calf Raise
description: Raise the heels by extending the ankles through a controlled range of motion.

name: Overhead Press
description: Press a barbell from shoulder height until the arms are extended overhead.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: Press dumbbells from shoulder height until the arms are extended overhead.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
description: Raise the machine arms outward to train the lateral deltoids.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: Raise dumbbells out to the sides until the arms approach shoulder height.

name: Rear Delt Fly
description: Move the arms outward against resistance while keeping a slight elbow bend.

name: Barbell Bicep Curl
description: Curl a barbell toward the shoulders without swinging the torso.

name: Spider Curl
description: Curl a barbell or dumbbells while the chest is supported on an incline bench.

name: Reverse Curl
description: Curl a barbell or cable attachment using a palms-down grip.

name: Cable Hammer Curl
description: Curl a rope attachment with the palms facing each other.

name: Forearm Curl
description: Flex the wrists against resistance with the palms facing upward.

name: Reverse Forearm Curl
description: Extend the wrists against resistance with the palms facing downward.

name: Cable Tricep Extension
description: Extend the elbows downward against a cable attachment.

name: Cable Overhead Tricep Extension
description: Extend the elbows overhead against a cable while keeping the upper arms stable.

name: Skull Crusher
description: Lower a bar toward the forehead by bending the elbows, then extend the arms.

name: Leg Raise
description: Raise the legs while keeping the torso stable to train the abdominal muscles.

name: Toes-to-Bar Leg Raise
description: Raise the legs from a hanging position until the toes approach the bar.

name: Kettlebell Oblique Crunch
description: Crunch laterally while holding a kettlebell to load the obliques.

name: Dumbbell Back Extension Oblique Crunch
description: Perform a weighted side crunch while positioned sideways on a back extension machine.

name: Plank
description: Hold a straight body position while supported by the forearms and toes.

name: Russian Twist
description: Rotate the torso from side to side while holding a seated position.

name: Sprint
description: Run at near-maximum speed for a short interval followed by recovery.

name: Running
description: Run at a steady or interval pace for cardiovascular conditioning.

name: Stationary Cycling
description: Pedal a stationary bike at a steady or interval pace.

name: Jump Rope
description: Perform repeated rope rotations and jumps for cardiovascular conditioning.
